A Proposal

Two brands. One home online.

A plan to take Rare Cut and Stone & Story from social feeds to fully owned online stores — built on Shopify, set up end to end, and ready to sell nationwide.

Prepared for the founder of Rare Cut & Stone & Story

The Recommendation

Shopify — one store per brand

Each brand gets its own store, its own look, and its own checkout — because a $5,000 heirloom piece and an everyday $60 necklace should never share a shelf. Both stores accept credit cards, Apple Pay, and Shop Pay, and both ship nationwide.

Two distinct storefronts, one platform to run them.

Rare Cut

Fine Jewelry · Old Money, Quietly

High-end pieces presented the way they deserve: near-black heritage green, antique gold, and a classic serif voice. Understated, assured, and priced without apology.

Shipping The buyer pays calculated shipping at checkout — insured rates, with a signature required on delivery. At this level it is expected; no one hesitates over insured shipping on a significant piece.

Stone & Story

Everyday Jewelry · Warm & Approachable

Beautiful pieces at prices that invite a first purchase — and a second. A warm, sunlit storefront that feels personal rather than precious.

Shipping Free shipping on orders over $75. At everyday price points, a shipping fee at checkout is the number-one reason carts are abandoned — the threshold removes it, and lifts the average order along the way.

Why Shopify

The platform jewelry brands grow on

Four reasons Shopify is the right foundation — each one chosen with jewelry margins and jewelry buyers in mind.

i.

A checkout that converts

Shop Pay and Apple Pay on a fast, one-page, mobile-first checkout. On jewelry margins, even a small lift in completed checkouts shows up quickly.

ii.

Real shipping tooling

Discounted labels, live carrier rates, and tracking built in — including insured, signature-on-delivery shipping for Rare Cut, set up in minutes.

iii.

Ad tracking, built in

Meta Pixel and the Conversions API are native to Shopify — server-side tracking of views, add-to-carts, and purchases, so ad targeting stays accurate even on iPhones. No workarounds.

iv.

Social storefronts, synced

The catalog syncs automatically to Instagram and Facebook Shops, so the pieces followers already love become buyable where they discover them.

Tracking from day one

The Meta Pixel and Conversions API are installed on both stores before launch. Every page view, add-to-cart, and purchase is measured server-side from the first order onward — nothing for you to set up, nothing missed.

The Investment

What it costs — paid directly to Shopify

There is no middleman. Shopify bills you directly for both stores, and you own both accounts outright.

Stone & Story Rare Cut
Shopify Basic $39/mo $29/mo on annual billing $39/mo $29/mo on annual billing
Card processing 2.9% + 30¢ via Shopify Payments 2.9% + 30¢ via Shopify Payments
Platform fee $0 with Shopify Payments $0 with Shopify Payments

Combined: ~$78/mo on monthly billing, or ~$58/mo on annual billing for both stores.

Because payments run through Shopify Payments, there is no additional 2% third-party gateway fee — the processing rate above is the whole story.

How We Work

Built for you, owned by you

I handle the complete build and setup of both stores — design, payments, shipping rules, tracking, and the Instagram and Facebook shop sync. I work through a Shopify Partner collaborator account, which means:

  • You keep full ownership of both stores, always.
  • Shopify bills you directly — your accounts, your store, your data.
  • No lock-in — collaborator access can be removed at any time.

Before Launch

Three things to settle first

  • Domains. Register one .com per brand before the build begins, so each store launches on its own address.
  • Brand names. Both “Rare Cut” and “Stone & Story” are in active jewelry use elsewhere, so an attorney trademark review comes before any branding spend.
  • Instagram. @stoneandstory appears available. @rarecut is taken, but @rarecutjewelry appears available.
